approach.title: Approach
approach.intro: I studied psychology before working with data, and it shows in how I treat it: behind every row there is a person making a decision.

behavior.title: Data describes behavior
behavior.text: Every event is someone’s decision. I design models and metrics that respect that context, not just the schema.

bias.title: Dashboards are read with biases
bias.text: Anchoring, confirmation, illusory causation. I design visualizations to help people decide, not to confirm what they already believed.

trust.title: Trusting a number is human
trust.text: Quality checks, data contracts and monitoring: reliable pipelines so people can make decisions with confidence.
